acc1.name: Trail compass
acc1.flavor: Brass compass, glass cracked but needle true. His father's. The glass broke on the last ridge they climbed together. The needle never lied, and neither did he.

acc2.name: Seed packet
acc2.flavor: A packet of seeds, her handwriting on the front. Plant after last frost. As if frost were still the problem.

acc3.name: Field suture kit
acc3.flavor: From the ambulance bag. Still packed the way you were taught — needle, thread, steady hands.

acc4.name: Dog Tags
acc4.flavor: Addison Barajas, your friend: carried Miriam home once, no questions.
